place.source_title: Chanute Air Force Base, Water Tower, Extender Street

brief: Steel multi-leg water tower: a round tank with a conical roof and a catwalk, on four tall braced legs with a central riser pipe, painted silver with the town name. Record gap: 2 photos.

facade.notes: the Chanute Air Force Base water tower (Rantoul IL, 1942), HABS: a steel tank with a round roof and catwalk on four braced legs and a central riser, standing between low brick and clapboard base buildings on a gravel lot

why.note: every town's water tower: height gives the mains their pressure, so the tower stands on the highest ground and becomes the town's landmark
